title: Joints.
officialText:
Joints between sections of connector piping and connections to flue collars and hood outlets shall be fastened by
one of the following methods:
1. Sheet metal screws.
2. Vent connectors of listed vent material assembled and connected to flue collars or draft hood outlets in accordance with the
manufacturers’ instructions.
3. Welding.
